articles.title: Strategy to repurchase $1.5 billion of 2029 convertible bonds using cash or bitcoin sales
articles.snippet: Led by Michael Saylor, the company aims to retire half of its outstanding 0% 2029 converts as it restructures liabilities tied to its bitcoin treasury strategy.

articles.title: Myanmar’s military government proposes life in prison for crypto scammers
articles.snippet: The text of Myanmar’s Anti-Online Fraud Bill said that anyone who was convicted of committing “digital currency fraud” could face from ten years to life in prison, and possibly the death penalty.

articles.title: Bitcoin risks ‘next downtrend’ as traders diverge on fate of $82K resistance
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traders split between a "massive catch-up" with stocks and the start of its "next downtrend" as BTC price action failed to flip $82,000 to support.

articles.title: UK politician Nigel Farage bought $1.8M house after $6.7M crypto gift
articles.snippet: The news follows growing calls from UK lawmakers and government officials to curb or temporarily ban crypto political donations in the country.

articles.title: Bitcoin trades at a 'discount' on Coinbase: Is a $76K retest next?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s $79,000 defense proves that the Coinbase discount is driven by stablecoin volatility rather than a lack of institutional demand.
